entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Tychon of Amathus was the Bishop of Amathus on the island of Cyprus from approximately 370 CE until his death in 403 CE. He played a crucial role in the early Christian Church, particularly in the region of Cyprus. Tychon is venerated as a saint by both Catholic and Orthodox Christians, and his feast day is June 29 in the Gregorian calendar. He was a key figure in the spread of Christianity in the Eastern Mediterranean, and his legacy continues to be celebrated in the region to this day.
